Test image observations: Mango leaf, mostly green with significant necrotic/brown lesions concentrated at the tip and upper edge of the leaf. The damage is extensive at the apex, with browning/dying tissue. Smaller brown spots scattered along the upper margin. This tip-dieback pattern is notable.

Now let me view one reference from each class, starting with Die_Back since the tip necrosis is prominent.
Die_Back ref 1: Completely brown/dried out leaf, fully necrotic. Much more severe than test image.
Anthracnose ref 1: Mostly yellowed/pale leaf with brown necrotic lesions at the tip/margins. Similar tip necrosis pattern. More yellowing overall though.
Powdery_Mildew ref 1: White/gray powdery coating across the leaf surface with spots. Very different from test image.

Sooty_Mould ref 1: Dark black/sooty patches over green leaf. Very different from test image.

Now I've covered all 4 classes. The test image shows tip/margin necrosis on an otherwise green leaf. Die_Back and Anthracnose are the top candidates. Let me look at more references for both.
Anthracnose ref 2: Green leaf with dark brown/black irregular lesions scattered across the middle — not tip-focused. The test image has more tip/margin necrosis pattern.
Die_Back ref 2: Fully dried/brown leaf hanging on stem — complete necrosis, very different from the test image which still has a mostly green leaf.

Anthracnose ref 3: Green leaf with discrete dark brown/black spots scattered across the blade — not tip-concentrated like the test image.

I have 1 view remaining. The tip/margin necrosis on an otherwise green leaf doesn't match Die_Back (fully dead leaves) or the scattered spot pattern of Anthracnose refs 2 & 3. Let me check one more Die_Back for early-stage examples.

Die_Back ref 3: Again, a fully brown/dead shriveled leaf. All three Die_Back references show complete necrosis.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: green mango leaf with heavy brown necrosis at the tip/apex, some marginal brown spots, otherwise green blade
- Die_Back refs: all show fully dead/brown leaves — too severe, doesn't match
- Anthracnose refs: mix of tip necrosis + scattered dark spots on green leaves — the tip/margin necrosis pattern in Anthracnose ref 1 is the closest visual match to the test image
- Powdery_Mildew: white powdery coating — clearly not a match
- Sooty_Mould: black sooty deposits — clearly not a match

The test image best matches **Anthracnose** — a green leaf with brown necrotic lesions concentrated at the tip and margins, consistent with anthracnose progression on mango leaves.
